main_text.l: per literas coluit; laetatus est Cardinalis,
talem, habere eorum, quae tunc Parisiis
qui sedis Apostolicae nuncium tunc ibi
git autem circa illud tempus, famosum
Patris Celloti Jesuitae Librum de Hierar-
chia & Hierarchis Parisiis in fronte testi-
monio; de hoc statim Cardinali Barbe-
quam illis, quibus in Patris Boni Libros
aut a Sorbona sperarentur, non aliunde
pro ea tempestate expectari posse, quam
per aliam Epistolam, quam ipsi nuncio
nificat, Celloti librum ab Episcopis Me-dun-

page.notes: The reference mark in the text is printed as a parenthesised z, "(z)"; it is given here as {z}. Word spacing in the first line is tight in the scan ("FrancisciCardinalisBarberini"); spaces were restored between the words. Printed forms left as they are: "Richelius", "animadversum", "Barbe-rino" (initial letter partly worn), "expectari". Line ends with "Me-" and the catchword "dun-" continue the same word.
